sources.evidence: Legacy clip-space diagonal/offset and fixed [0,1] host depth. TransformVertices copies all four payload DWORDs, reports raw logical homogeneous coordinates, offscreen is the intersection of clip flags. Rejected output values and unsafe pointers/undersized strides are not pinned native contracts.
TRANSFORM uses D3DFVF_LVERTEX and TRANSFORMLIGHT uses D3DFVF_VERTEX. Wine marks NOCOLOR and UPDATEEXTENTS incomplete; bounded project behavior is tested separately.
Legacy Set/Get projection cache and input * oldLogicalProjection Multiply order; physical logicalProjection * clipspace.
Windows position/payload, scale, clipping, offscreen and D3DVIEWPORT2 vectors around 12500-13130.
Wine multiply_matrix uses reversed parameter order, unlike project d3d7_multiply_matrix.

scope: S2-52: execute TRANSFORM retains LVERTEX diffuse/specular/UV and does not require lighting preparation. Legacy V1 scale and V2 clip rectangle/depth are composed after logical application projection; host viewport depth is always [0,1]. Device2/3 logical Set/Get/Multiply, Execute STATETRANSFORM, GPU draws, CPU ProcessVertices and explicit-viewport TransformVertices share effective projection. TransformVertices preserves 16-byte payload, raw pre-clip homogeneous output and exact offscreen clip intersection; explicit noncurrent viewport does not mutate current state. Existing bounded stride/NULL validation and zero-W policy are retained rather than reproducing native crashes; undersized output/input strides are refused. Rejected XYZW is Wine implementation behavior, not a native test oracle. NOCOLOR retains both stored colors and UPDATEEXTENTS/source bounds are project regression contracts, not full native conformance claims. Native 2281 checks, 128 reactivations and 128 prelit passes, 16 runtime mutants, ASAN/UBSAN and old actual viewport/execute functions with new helper definitions runtime control. XP 2 viewports x3 projections x3 draw routes =18 readbacks, 36 CPU position/payload checks and 12 logical projection queries. CPU replies are explicit transport controls, not GPU pixel evidence. Actual SwiftShader and Metal replay checks independent 16x16 color/coverage/depth scene expectations with explicit LIGHTING=FALSE for the prelit scene; Clear touches the viewport only and the rest of the initially zero texture remains zero. Mixed Device7/legacy state-block private metadata, full viewport validation quirks, execute clipping/lighting flag conformance, S2-53/54/55/57, broad ownership/Reset/thread/device-loss/format, native HAL, games/FPS and review stages4/5/6 remain open. Host/protocol/shader/bundle and D3D8/9 unchanged.
